definitions.supplemental: He het fecchen a ueat, and wið pich fullen, and wallen. hit walmhāt. Jul. 69, 20.

quotations.old_english: Him brego engla wylmhātne līg tō wræce sende

source_text: wilm-h&a-long;t; adj. Burning hot :-- Him brego engla wylmh&a-long;tne l&i-long;g t&o-long; wræce sende, Cd. Th. 156, 5 ; Gen. 2584. [He het fecchen a ueat, and wi&d-bar; pich fullen, and wallen. hit walmh&a-long;t. Jul. 69, 20.]
